name: co.founden.glp1pricesco/glp1-price-index
title: GLP1Prices.co: daily US price index of tirzepatide and semaglutide
description: Daily US cash prices of tirzepatide and semaglutide by provider, lowest first, each with its source.

tools.name: find_glp1_prices
tools.description: Today's lowest US cash prices for tirzepatide or semaglutide, lowest cost per 30 days first, in the same order as the GLP1Prices.co page the answer links. Ask for an ingredient ("tirzepatide" gives its compounded list and its brands), a compounded product ("compounded semaglutide") or a brand ("Zepbound", "Mounjaro", "Wegovy", "Ozempic"). Each row gives the provider, the product, the price in the provider's own words, its plan length and any fee billed beside it, the cost per 30 days, the day it was read, the page it was read on, and whether GLP1Prices.co may earn a referral commission on it.

medication.description: An ingredient, a compounded product or a brand, e.g. "tirzepatide", "compounded semaglutide", "Zepbound".

limit.description: How many prices to return per list. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: find_seller_glp1_prices
tools.description: Every current tirzepatide and semaglutide price of one US provider (a telehealth clinic, a pharmacy or a maker's own program), lowest cost per 30 days first; prices the order cannot rank follow in other_prices with the reason. Each row gives the product, the price in the provider's own words, its plan and fees, the day it was read and its source page, with the provider's page on GLP1Prices.co.

tools.name: list_glp1_medications
tools.description: The price lists the GLP1Prices.co index keeps (compounded tirzepatide and semaglutide, and each brand it prices), with how many ranked prices each has today and its page.
